_comment: Frozen SK detector description for the WAND production. Pinned so edits to SK_physics_config.json cannot silently change the campaign; fspec is written out explicitly rather than inherited from detector_params._ANGULAR_REFL_DEFAULTS. Reflection rates were the placeholder 0.2/0.2 for campaigns up to 2026-09-28, then raised deliberately to the measured values below, in step with SK_physics_config.json. Every WAND output is being regenerated for the first-hit deposit and leg bound, so this costs no extra generation. Datasets written before 2026-09-28 (WAND/{SK,HK,SK_WAND,SK_hktwin}) used 0.2/0.2 and are a DIFFERENT generation, not extra statistics for this one.
_comment_reflection: wall: SK black PET liner, R~0.05, ~55% specular [Abe et al., NIM A737 (2014) 253]. sensor: PMT glass + bialkali photocathode from water, R~0.25, ~90% specular [Motta & Schonert, NIM A539 (2005) 217].

trigger._note: SK trigger: n_thr 25 is HK's 45 scaled by the PMT count (45 x 11096/19746 = 25.3), which leaves SK a smaller dark-noise margin: per 200 ns window SK sees 7.2 +- 2.7 dark digits, so 25 is the mean + 6.7 sigma and continuous dark noise alone opens 8.4 Hz of gates (42 in 5 s simulated); HK sees 15.3 +- 3.9 and 45 is the mean + 7.6 sigma (none in 2 s). Revalidated 2026-11-16 at the measured reflectivity (0.05 wall / 0.25 sensor), this block applied offline to untriggered data: on 60 GeV muons (GeV/02_mu, dark over 500 ns) every event triggers, 100.00% of muon and 99.89% of Michel digits kept, 0 dark-only gates, mean gate 1183 ns, a Michel gets its own gate in 24 of 53 events; single electrons uniform in the volume (1-12 MeV, events with >= 1 physics hit) are 90% efficient (a gate holds one of their digits) at 2.6 MeV kinetic energy (2.9 MeV at n_thr 26, 3.4 MeV at 30). First validated 2026-07-23 at 0.2 / 0.2 on WAND/SK/GeV config_06: 300 events, physics efficiency 100.0% on every event, 1-5 gates/event.
